notes.title: Persona 5 Strikers Version 1.02
notes.content:
Hello Persona 5 Strikers players! This release is Persona 5 Strikers, version 1.2. 

Thank you for reporting issues and participating in our Beta releases! Your feedback and involvement are crucial. We have rolled our beta patch over to the Main Branch. This release contains previous gameplay and stability issues addressed with Hot Fix 1 and Hot Fix 2. Here is a comprehensive list of fixes made: 

[list] 

[*]Increased stability of the game against crashes and hang issues. 

[*]Addressed an issue in which some users are getting an error message that the game cannot be run on their current OS, even though they are using Windows 10.[/list]

notes.title: Please try the open beta branch for Persona 5 Strikers!
notes.content:
Hello Phantom Thieves! 

Thank you for reporting your issues with Persona 5 Strikers. 

Our team has addressed a number of issues reported and have rolled them to the beta branch. A full list of the issues addressed are listed at the bottom of this message. 

This is an opt-in hotfix, so if you would like to opt in, please do the following: 

From Persona 5 Strikers in your Steam library, right click and go to Properties. Navigate to the BETAS tab and enter the beta access code: 

H5328QXV3R74myei3uhh6ab2Pa5pUitjmVh 

From the drop down menu, select “hotfix1”. 

Issues addressed in this hotfix: 

[list]
[*] Increased stability of the game against crashes and hang issues.  
[*] Addressed an issue in which some users are getting an error message that the game cannot be run on their current OS, even though they are using Windows 10. 
[/list]

If you are not experiencing any major issues, we recommend not opting into the beta branch. 

UPDATE: 4/12/2021

Thank you for reporting issues and participating in our Beta release! Your feedback and involvement are crucial as we continue to improve the Steam release. 
 
We have prepared Hotfix 2, which should further increase stability of the game against crashes and hang issues. 
 
Here’s how to access it: 
 
Branch Name: hotfix2 
Branch Password: jE29Ct7V3gGf3CWpYwrKeSEY9KVRUUZKr

If you are not experiencing further issues with hotfix 1 we recommend not opting into the latest branch.

Please post issues in this thread regarding this beta so that we can further identify technical issues. We appreciate your feedback and information you provided us. 

Thank you! 

ATLUS Comms

notes.title: Take Control of the Phantom Thieves of Hearts!
notes.content:
[b]The Phantom Thieves are back and better than ever!  [/b]

Take control of all Phantom Thieves and use their unique playstyles and combat abilities to tear through swarms of enemies in an all-new hybrid battle system! Plan your strategy and utilize each teammate to their fullest with elemental attacks, ambushes, and special abilities. 

[previewyoutube=mtegLxhhtkc;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s a taste of what you can expect from each character: 

[list]
[*] [b]Joker [/b]has high attack power and mobility, darting in with his dagger for quick close-range attacks. 
[*] [b]Sophie [/b]is a mysterious girl who meets the Phantom Thieves in the Shibuya Metaverse. She uses a yo-yo to quickly attack a large number of enemies and a blaster for her Gun attacks.
[*] [b]Skull [/b]can rush headfirst into battle with high attack and defense capabilities. Charge up your attacks to increase their damage and range! 
[*] [b]Mona[/b] wields a shortsword and is an agile fighter who can unleash attacks both on the ground and in the air. He can also lock onto multiple enemies using his slingshot! 
[*] [b]Panther [/b]wields a whip in battle. Her attacks have a wide range and can hit multiple enemies. She can also ignite her whip with flames and add the Fire element to her attacks! 
[*] [b]Fox [/b]wields a katana. He boasts high attack power and can strike enemies multiple times. He can also unleash a flurry of attacks and counter as he sheathes his sword!  
[*] [b]Queen [/b]is a close-range fighter who uses her fists as her weapons. She can use various nuclear skills while riding on her bike-shaped Persona and can fire her revolver for rapid gun attacks!  
[*] [b]Oracle [/b]acts as the Phantom Thieves’ navigator, analyzing their surroundings and enemy data. By observing combat situations, she can report the team's ailments, discover the weaknesses of enemies, and chart the team's movements! 
[*] [b]Noir [/b]wields an axe when fighting and can connect her Psychokinesis and Gun attacks to her regular attacks! Her gun, a grenade launcher, has high attack power and range. 
[/list]

Join the battle to liberate hearts when Persona 5 Strikers releases next month, and play the full game 4 days early with the Digital Deluxe edition!
